captions: Town hall. Ticket A52. They're still on A47.
Your phone buzzes again. “Mum.” You press decline.
You type: “busy, call you later.” Later never comes.
An old woman beside you sighs: “My son never calls.”
Her eyes look exactly like your mother's.
Outside, you call back. She answers on the first ring.
“Nothing important,” she says. “I just missed your voice.”
Fourteen minutes. Her knees, the neighbours, your childhood.
The smallest good deed of your week. Allah saw every minute.

verses.text: “So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.”

post.caption:
Allah gave you one mother. 5 missed calls today. 🌙

A queue at the town hall, ticket A52, and you press decline on “Mum” — again. Then an old woman next to you sighs: “My son never calls.”

“So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.” (99:7)

Before Maghrib today: call her. No reason needed.
